pyq_bad.why: suspect key: full name is All India Trinamool Congress, none of the options is right
garbled options (first numbers missing); wrong topic: post-independence chronology

patterns: Direct single-fact items: year of CPI split (1964), NCP split from Congress (1999), first BJP president (Vajpayee).
Party-leader pair matching (UPSC 2024 style: Jana Sangh-S.P. Mookerjee, Congress for Democracy-Jagjivan Ram) with 'how many pairs correct' format.
Recognition questions ask which party is/is not a national party - status changes over time (NCP, CPI lost it in 2023) are traps.
Concept terms: inner-party democracy, Kamaraj Plan, social base of parties.
App MCQs go deeper into laws (Sec 29A, funding caps, court cases) and AP leaders than the PYQs, but are factually sound.
